targets: Return the Flow: Move an Ally
modifier.precondition: Target yourself instead of an ally.

effects.evidence: Move up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from creatures that are Soaked or standing in one of your Currents or Basins

notes: water_return resolves the optional self-target and selective Opportunity Attacks through native granted movement; its owned passive row offers native free standing after a qualifying turn start.
